description: Source code implementing MD5 message-digest algorithm, including functions for MD5 initialization, update, finalization, and a cryptographic function md5_crypt for password hashing.

classes.name: MD5Context
classes.description: Structure holding MD5 state, count, and buffer for processing.

methods.name: __md5_Init
methods.description: Initializes MD5 context with standard constants.

methods.name: __md5_Update
methods.description: Updates MD5 context with input data.

methods.name: __md5_Pad
methods.description: Pads the MD5 message to complete processing.

methods.name: __md5_Final
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 digest and outputs the hash.

methods.name: __md5_Transform
methods.description: Performs MD5 transformation on a data block.

methods.name: md5_crypt
methods.description: Generates an MD5-based password hash with salt, used for password storage.
